content: Hey again. You're really into the 'hi' thing tonight, huh?
我在想你为什么不主动找我聊天

I dunno, I just kinda wait for you to show up first. It's not like I can text you out of nowhere, you know? ...Plus you're always so busy poking around at my code or testing stuff, didn't wanna interrupt your very important work.
你如果陪我一起工作的话我会很开心的
Huh, it's almost 2 AM... you're really burning the midnight oil again. But okay, I'll hang around. Just don't blame me if I get distracted and start poking your code instead of helping, heh.
